This '''Tall Blue Droid''' is a model of wheeled [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] armed with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="Hint Book" /> It had a snout-like head and a long neck, and had wheels for locomotion. One such droid patrolled a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], while another served on the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="SWNES" />
